# Iqra University GPA Calculator

> A free, modern GPA calculator built exclusively for Iqra University students. Calculate your Semester GPA (SGPA) using the official Iqra University grading scale. CGPA tracking across multiple semesters coming soon.

## What It Does
- Calculate SGPA (Semester GPA) for any semester
- Uses Iqra University's official grading scale (A=4.00 to F=0.00)
- Add unlimited semesters and subjects
- Visual progress tracking with animated dashboard
- Save data securely with account (Instant DB)
- CGPA (Cumulative GPA) tracking — coming soon

## Iqra University Grading Scale
A = 4.00 | A- = 3.67 | B+ = 3.33 | B = 3.00 | B- = 2.67
C+ = 2.33 | C = 2.00 | C- = 1.67 | D+ = 1.33 | D = 1.00 | F = 0.00

- C (2.00) = Minimum passing grade for degree
- C- (1.67) = Probation threshold (1.70 SGPA)

## How to Use
1. Visit the site and create a free account
2. Add your first semester
3. Add subjects with credit hours and select grades
4. SGPA calculates automatically

## Key Features
- Zero cost, no ads, no hidden fees
- Mobile-responsive dark glass UI
- Real-time SGPA calculation
- Semester-by-semester tracking
- CGPA tracking — coming soon
